glyph_origin: Phono-semantic compound (形聲): semantic 合 (“to meet”) + phonetic 𡆧. 𡆧 is the original form of 𨭗 (“ironware”) (Ji Xusheng (2004)).
senses: [huì] economic or political centre; major city
[kuài] (obsolete in standard Chinese) to compute; to calculate; to sum; to do accounting
note: glyph_origin is from the traditional page 會; s_page_origin explains the simplified 会.
